waypoints.name: Elbow Lake Trailhead (Trail #697, FR-38)
waypoints.directions: From SR 9 north of Sedro-Woolley, turn right onto Mosquito Lake Road just after crossing the South Fork Nooksack and drive about 9 miles. Just past the Middle Fork Nooksack bridge, turn right onto FR 38 and drive about 11 miles to the Elbow Lake Trailhead on the right, with parking across the road. The road is gated at Wallace Creek, 1.3 miles short, from Dec 1 to Jun 15. A Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required.
